en.gameDesc: Apply the inclusion-exclusion principle to compute set unions, intersections, and complements. Solve derangement problems and use Venn diagrams to visualize.

af.gameDesc: Pas die insluiting-uitsluitingsbeginsel toe om verenigings, snydings, en komplemente van versamelings te bereken. Los ontrangskikkingsprobleme op en gebruik Venn-diagramme vir visualisering.

zu.gameDesc: Sebenzisa umthetho wokufaka-ukukhipha ukubala izinyunyana zamaqoqo, izinqamulelo, namakhomplimenti. Xazulula izinkinga zokuphazamisa usebenzise amadayagramu kaVenn ukukubona.
